headline: Vote on proposed bylaw change and EXCOM slate, plus farewell to five longtime members.
summary: The meeting will cover a proposed bylaw change to the organization's structure and a vote on the EXCOM slate starting December 1st. It will also include an executive director report and a farewell to five longtime members.
items: Executive Director report: staff update for Lindsay deCsipkes and Camille Bisson
Recap of Monday Morning Drop By on November 2
Presentation to HEDC with meeting update and HEDD newsletter, January or February to be determined
Annual Report to City on November 16
Nominating Committee proposed bylaw change to CP structure
Vote for EXCOM slate to begin December 1st
Farewell to longstanding board members Kate Anker, Daniel Minter, David Brenerman, Gib Foltz and Clare Hannan
2027 board dates: January 6, February 3, April 7, May 5, June 9
location: CP HQ, 84 Free Street, Portland, ME 04101

84 Free Street | Portland, ME | 04101 | 207-370-4784 
 
 
Board of Directors Meeting 
Wednesday, November 4, 2026 
3:30 PM 
IN PERSON at CP HQ 
 
To submit written public comment on an Agenda item, please send an email to 
edd@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions must be received by 12:00 p.m. the day before the 
Creative Portland Corporation Board meeting 
to guarantee their inclusion in the Agenda packet. 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
1. Welcome and President's Comments (Herb Ivy)  
  A. Consent Agenda: October minutes & September financials 
VOTE: to accept consent agenda 
      
2. Executive Director Report (Dinah Minot)  
  A. Staff update - Lindsay deCsipkes & Camille Bisson 
      
  B. Monday Morning Drop By - Nov 2 recap 
      
  C. Presentation to HEDC - meeting update & HEDD newsletter - Jan/Feb tbd 
      
  D. Annual Report to City - Nov 16th 
      
3. Board Business  
  A. Nominating Committee proposed bylaw change to CP structure 
      
  B. Vote for EXCOM slate to begin December 1st 
      
  C. Farewell to longstanding Board members Kate Anker, Daniel Minter, David Brenerman, Gib 
Foltz & Clare Hannan 
      
4. Board Share  
5. 2027 Board Dates: January 6, Feb 3, April 7, May 5, June 9
